positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
An internship at CSUSB in collaboration with NASA Armstrong with the goal of measuring drone propeller shape versus efficiency.
Help design and assemble a station for testing propeller efficiency by using RaspberryPi, Oscilloscopes, prototyping boards and function generators.
Assembled and test flew quadcopters to gather data.
